title: 冬の星空と星座
subject_en: Night-sky motifs in flat style: deep indigo, yellow and pale blue only, each a separate item (constellation drawn as a few star points joined by a thin line plus a small simple creature shape, telescope, shooting star). No letters. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: オリオン、おおいぬ、すばる、流れ星、天体望遠鏡。冬の夜空を楽しむイラスト12点。天体観察のおたよりやポスターに。
items: the Orion constellation shown as a hunter figure formed by yellow stars and thin lines
a dog shaped constellation made of yellow stars and thin lines
a cluster of six bright blue-white stars
a shooting star with a curved glowing tail of small stars
a telescope on a tripod pointing up
a crescent moon with two small stars
a full moon with soft crater marks
the back view of a child in a coat and scarf looking up at stars
a small rocket flying up with a flame and tiny stars
a round planisphere star chart with a rotating disc
a hanging lantern shaped like a star glowing yellow
